description: Use this when the host asks how many interview results they have left, what their interview allowance and credit balance is, or why invitations or the public link are on hold. Do not use it for another account's balance, for another service's usage or to transcribe a recording. It returns the host's interview allowance and credit balance. Each finished session that produces a report uses one result from them. Invitations are held and the public link stops taking new people when both run out, and they carry on once credits are added. When the balance is low or used up, the reply explains how this affects new invitations and public links and where credits are added.
name: get_balance
title: Get the balance
